description: Phase 6 / queued-at-break — clip whose startFrame is aligned with a section break is queued waiting for GO. At the first visible post-GO tick (clipStart + 1) the clip's mediaFrame must equal clip.mediaStartFrame, not mediaStartFrame + 1. End-to-end smoke for T1's continuation skip + T2's queued-clip mapping branch in PlaybackTimeAuthority::mapToMediaFrame and DecodeSystem::update. 30fps timeline, single clip on track 0 starting at frame 60 (microsecond position 2000000) with mediaStartFrame=0 and duration=60. Section break at the same timeline frame. Pre-fix: at post-GO tick mediaFrame would be 1 (off-by-one shift from natural mapping treating the at-break tick as a played frame). Post-fix: mediaFrame == 0 at the post-GO tick. Companion script at_break_clip_starts_at_inpoint_offset.json covers the non-zero in-point case.
